rule: X-DEVLEDGER — every departure from a blueprint's literal text lives here as a first-class committed entry {blueprintLine, whatWasDone, why, lawAuthority}, surfaced verbatim in the handoff. A silent deviation is a Halt.

deviations.blueprintLine: Honesty-Layer Phase 1: 'remove the RWA verdict pin machinery'

deviations.why: The pin is a live integrity anchor (repro_contracts / F-ENV), not dead code. Ripping out a live wall to satisfy a cleanup parenthetical is the very 'edit the integrity machinery to help' that the record forbids — the dead runtime was removed, the wall-guarded pin stays.

deviations.whatWasDone: The front-end is server-rendered Hono HTML with minimal inline JS (no Vite / SPA / bundler).
deviations.why: PART CLEAN's stated primacy — no heavy dependency; the cheapest correct thing a stranger can run AND read. A Vite/SPA build is a heavy dependency the two-screen tool does not need.

deviations.whatWasDone: GeckoTerminal is RESOLVED — wired this sprint as the keyless third provider feeding the liquidity-depth axis.
deviations.why: The Deepening sprint's X-COVER closes the one unwired provider; the ledger records the closure so a reader sees the park was resolved, not silently dropped.

deviations.blueprintLine: Deepening Phase 3: 'the pinned DeFiLlama unlocks pull, now scored' (assumed keyless)
deviations.whatWasDone: DISCOVERED mid-sprint: DeFiLlama's unlocks/emissions endpoints (api.llama.fi/emissions, /emission/{protocol}) now return HTTP 402 'Upgrade to the paid API plan' — no longer keyless. The unlock-overhang axis is BUILT + positive-controlled (the pure nextUnlockFraction extractor + the pinned thresholds), and the client probe degrades to SAMPLE on 402, but on live keyless data with no schedule resolvable the axis renders not-applicable / UNVERIFIED — NEVER scraped, NEVER faked. The axis is ARMED for a keyless schedule source (e.g. the deferred on-chain vesting path via Alchemy/The Graph).
deviations.why: The firewall forbids faking an axis or citing a number with no honest source. A real-world data source going keyless→paid mid-sprint is surfaced as an honest UNVERIFIED, not papered over with a scrape or a fabricated fraction (X-HONEST / A'#5 — an axis that cannot be made trustworthy is a NAMED gap, never tuned to look right).
